532:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

532:t_1:5.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「So you do see $c as special.」

532:t_1:7.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That people who reached such a level were left unattended is a grave matter.」

532:t_1:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Probably because of this universe's jurisdiction... and furthermore the dimensional cage.」

532:t_1:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What are you talking about?」

532:t_1:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It's still none of your concern.」

532:t_1:11.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You're hard on newcomers, Your Majesty the Emperor. So basically, until I steal the $$いがみ合う双子$$, I'm treated as half-baked.」

532:t_1:12.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「If you understand that, I have nothing more to say.」

532:t_1:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Mind if I come along?」

532:t_1:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「My target is not the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

532:t_1:17.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「So it's that one who disturbs your void.」

532:t_1:19.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Understood. Just the thought of getting swallowed up by your bloodlust as collateral damage is enough to put me off.」

532:t_1:20.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「This half-baked one will quietly stay behind and mind the place.」

532:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Heh... An interesting woman.」

532:t_1:23.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Without at least that much spirit, one has no right to this seat.」

532:t_1:24.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「In that sense, all of $c's Reactors possess fitting power as well. The $$いがみ合う双子$$ included.」

532:t_1:25.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「To think there are two humans who can awaken that thing.」

532:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「It must be because of the peculiarity of this planet called Earth.」

532:t_1:27.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Is it because the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers here...? Or is it precisely because it is like this that the $$オリジン・ロー$$ gathers...」

532:t_1:29.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And the power held by this planet's humans is gradually starting to take shape...」

532:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Echoing the movements of $c in every region, rifts are appearing along the front. If this continues, the wind may well change.」

532:t_1:32.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Be careful, $$尸空#pilot$$. I still cannot read that one's intentions...」

532:t_1:36.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Captain's Cabin ～

532:t_1:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「...So you were the ones who recovered Al.」

532:t_1:38.en:
$$レイス$$
「I'm glad the ARX-8 proved useful.」

532:t_1:39.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Intelligence Division seems to have had a hard time too since $$ミスリル$$ was wiped out.」

532:t_1:40.en:
$$レイス$$
「Yes. But we can't let $$アマルガム$$ or the Empire do as they please with the world.」

532:t_1:41.en:
$$レイス$$
「The Intelligence Division is operating independently. Sending your AS's core unit to the remnants of the Research Division was one of those moves.」

532:t_1:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I was surprised when $$レイス$$ contacted me during the battle.」

532:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I thought the ARX project... had been completely terminated.」

532:t_1:44.en:
$$レイス$$
「It's true that the project was frozen after the chief developer's death.」

532:t_1:45.en:
$$レイス$$
「But because Al himself wanted a new body of his own, development of the ARX-8 resumed and reached completion.」

532:t_1:46.en:
$$レイス$$
「Incidentally, the name $$レーバテイン$$ is one Al chose himself. Do you know its origin?」

532:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「A friend who knows the occult told me. Apparently it's the name of a sword from mythology.」

532:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I suppose Al took that name as a power stronger than the $$アーバレスト$$.」

532:t_1:49.en:
$$レイス$$
「Though what really led to its completion was probably the fact that excellent staff joined the Research Division.」

532:t_1:51.en:
$$レイス$$
「That's right. $$クダン・ミラ$$ was involved in its development.」

532:t_1:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... Is that $$クダン・ミラ$$ then, as I suspected...」

532:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... Like me and $$カナメ$$, she is a 《$$ウィスパード$$》.」

532:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Don't you remember, $$相良$$? The girl you saved in Siberia before you became $$カナメ$$'s bodyguard.」

532:t_1:58.en:
$$レイス$$
「I have a message for you from $$ミラ$$, Sergeant. She wants to meet you and thank you for what happened back then.」

532:t_1:59.en:
$$レイス$$
「Though you probably can't spare the time for that right now.」

532:t_1:61.en:
$$レイス$$
「Our own investigations have also confirmed changes in $$アマルガム$$'s organizational structure.」

532:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You mean it is changing from the democratic council-based organization it has been so far into one with a dictatorial power structure.」

532:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「And the one standing at the top is...」

532:t_1:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

532:t_1:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to $$カナメ$$'s transmission, he is now on the border between life and death.」

532:t_1:66.en:
$$レイス$$
「Most likely, $$アマルガム$$ will not take any overt action until that situation becomes clear.」

532:t_1:67.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I'll leave the pursuit to the Intelligence Division. Please investigate their movements, as well as the organization's ultimate objective.」

532:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I simply cannot believe that $$レナード$$ truly swears loyalty to the Empire from the heart.」

532:t_1:70.en:
$$レイス$$
「The $$時空震動弾$$ that $$アマルガム$$ developed, you mean.」

532:t_1:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... We need to confirm as soon as possible what he intends to use it for.」

532:t_1:72.en:
$$レイス$$
「Understood. In the meantime, what does $c intend to do?」

532:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since $$ゼロ$$ has made a proposal as well, we will head for $$新日本$$.」

532:t_1:77.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

532:t_1:80.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$. The first line is 'Sousuke... I really love you.'」

532:t_1:81.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't get it wrong, Al. It's Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$ to you.」

532:t_1:82.en:
$$アル$$
「Congratulations on your promotion, Master Sergeant.」

532:t_1:84.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Could it be, Al... that you recorded everything $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$ said to each other back then?」

532:t_1:85.en:
$$アル$$
「Important information may be hidden in it, so I have recorded everything.」

532:t_1:86.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hand over that data! This is great material for teasing $$宗介$$!」

532:t_1:88.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$マオ$$ is right! Even bad taste has its limits!」
